prompt: After configuring Apache to run inside a chroot prison as a non-root user, `httpd` no longer starts. What is the main cause?
choices: `mod_chroot` needs the absolute path to the chroot environment
Apache cannot read `index.html` because it was not moved into the chroot
Apache requires a `VirtualHost` directive when run from a chroot
Apache needs to start as root to bind to port `80`
A `LoadModule` line for `mod_chroot` must be added to `httpd.conf`
explanation: Binding to a privileged port (`80`) requires starting as root; Apache then drops privileges to the configured user.
